62: ### P02 — 원천 snapshot과 distinct occurrence
63: 
64: 실제 source에는 definition/effect origin, actor/provider, transient item ID와 알려진 persistent copy를 구분해 보존한다. action/cast, carrier step iteration/target의 direct strike, effect/component segment는 각각 다른 key다. strike key는 수식 전에 만들어 한 strike의 다중 segment가 여러 hit로 부풀지 않게 한다. hit 자격은 기존 HP-loss gate를 보존한다.
65: 
66: 현재 skill command·trigger batch·queued buff application/tick·ScheduleAttack·projectile/area에 immutable causal context를 전달한다. 지연 효과는 caster/control 상태가 사라져도 필요한 bounded source를 보유한다. 실제 확보하지 못한 legacy origin/root/copy는 명시적인 부재다. log sequence는 narration 연결용으로 보존할 수 있지만 fact 권위 key는 log 보관과 독립이다. arbitrary recursive history 대신 현재 producer를 연결하는 bounded context를 사용한다. full chain visited/true join/periodic root는 해당 후속 owner에 남는다.

66: The existing damage formula applies combined component damage in one HP mutation. Do not invent a per-component share of overkill HP loss. Preserve each component's requested/calculated damage, type, source and segment ordinal; the actual HP transition belongs to the mutation that contains those components. Multiple damage mutations in one strike share strike identity but retain their own actual transitions. Existing `CommandExecutionSummary.actual_damage_target_count` and previous-step HP-loss gates continue to use the old calculations; new distinct-strike summary counters do not change that gate.
67: 
68: `FactSummary` keeps checked counts/totals and bounded latest/latest-nonzero witnesses for each actual fact kind, including the last relevant strike/segment source and predeath state. Actor and provider summaries make distinct actual equipment copies observable even when their effects execute in the same operation. A current strike may retain bounded segment calculation details until its summary is finalized; do not append every past mutation/event to an attempt history. Promised action receipts retain their compact aggregate and bounded witnesses, not an unbounded list of effects.
69: 
70: Predeath preparation captures the target's identity, position, pre-lethal HP and relevant currently active buff keys/application sources before any cleanup. Capture and native/authoring admission precede the lethal mutation. Finalization commits the mandatory Death fact and wave bookkeeping exactly once; optional OnDeath/OnKill/ally/proc dispatch remains separate. Damage, signed Heal/stat-HP lethal and direct summon Kill all enter this boundary; Despawn stays distinct. Preserve existing reaction order and sorted ally order, and do not run a new predeath reaction.

72: ## 4. Source propagation and actual equipment copy
73: 
74: Introduce `BattleEquipmentBinding { base_uuid: Uuid, persistent_copy_uuid: Option<Uuid> }` as the element of `BattleUnitDraft.equipped_items`. Both real player draft producers in `combat_setup/player_spawns.rs:169,244` use the actual equipped inventory instance UUID. Both runtime constructors in `core/build.rs:139,263` copy it into `RuntimeItem`. Weapon/stat lookup reads `binding.base_uuid`. Keep `make_item_instance_id(base, side, unit, index)`, enhancement aggregation, cooldown keys and RNG identity unchanged.
